==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Willing myself into sleep paralysis, I attain lucidity. I fly a ghostly UFO to an elf village. There I train with a Death Witch and learn the art of geomancy from her. Refusing her evil path, I use my powers to defeat the barbaric alligator men of the valley.
